name: VeriCrypt
tagline: An air-gapped compliance engine that finds the cryptography in an estate, scores its quantum exposure, and produces reports a regulator can verify offline.

audience.concern: Know which cryptography is exposed to quantum attack, what to fix first, and how to show regulators.
Verify a compliance report offline, without trusting the vendor or the institution.
Run the engine inside an air-gapped environment from a single binary.

highlights.title: Air-gapped by design
highlights.text: A single static binary does the work inside your environment, with no network access needed during a scan.

highlights.title: Reports you can verify offline
highlights.text: Each .pqc report is tamper-evident and carries post-quantum signatures. The offline verifier checks it on any machine.

highlights.title: Regulatory logic that replays
highlights.text: Regulatory axioms run on a deterministic virtual machine, and a report embeds the execution trace so a verifier can replay it.

highlights.title: Optional services stay optional
highlights.text: Anything that leaves the air-gapped core is a separate, one-way, user-initiated step.

verifyIt: Open a .pqc report in the verifier, check its signature and Merkle proof, then change one byte and watch verification fail.

demo.title: Verify a compliance report
demo.summary: Open a sample report, check it, then tamper with it and see verification fail.
